summary: COM-like object destruction: guards on the object pointer at a1, runs the vtable destruction chain (slot 2 at vtable+8 release, slot 6 at vtable+24 cleanup, then slot 0 delete with argument 1), and nulls the caller's pointer. Returned value is the last call result. Called by DoubleBufferFree (0x004F83B0).

operations.description: Guard: proceed only when the object pointer stored at a1 (field obj+0x0) is non-null; otherwise return immediately.
Call vtable slot 2 (function pointer at vtable+8) on the object; this is the first destruction-phase callback.
Call vtable slot 6 (function pointer at vtable+24) on the object; this is the second destruction-phase callback, whose return value becomes the function result.
Guard: re-check the object pointer at a1 (field obj+0x0) before the delete call.
Call vtable slot 0 (function pointer at vtable+0) on the object with argument 1; this is the final delete/free call.
Null the caller's output pointer at a1 (field this+0x0) after destruction.
Return the result of the last executed destruction callback (or the unmodified pointer value when the initial guard fails).
